answer: TREM2+ microglia-like (TML) macrophages are predicted to co-locate with Schwann cells and interact with them (via VEGFA-NRP1, VEGFA-NRP2, SEMA3C-NRP2, SEMA3E-PLXND1) to contribute to synapse formation and axon guidance, suggesting they support establishment of the skin peripheral nervous system during early gestation.
support_quote: TML macrophages were predicted to interact with Schwann cells, contributing to synapse formation and axon guidance (VEGFA–NRP1, VEGFA–NRP2, SEMA3C–NRP2 and SEMA3E–PLXND1) (Extended Data Fig. 8h and Supplementary Table 8). These findings suggest that prenatal skin macrophages may support the establishment of the skin peripheral nervous system during early gestation, as previously reported in mouse skin.
